text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I came up with a new algorithm, but I 
don't even feel like putting it 
together...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I know full well that just ignoring 
motivation and plowing through the work is 
more efficient, but still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. I'll jot down the ideas I had 
and make it tomorrow instead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur seems fatigued from running 
consecutive races. I might need to rethink 
our future schedule.
